commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' The current number of shots on goal is 1:5.

86' The St Etienne players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
83' A corner kick by Lens is thwarted by the well prepared Gautier Larsonneur (St Etienne).
82' Olivier Dall'Oglio has decided to substitute Yunis Abdelhamid and he is replaced by Dylan Batubinsika (St Etienne).

78' Great teamplay by Lens as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

56' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
52' Neat passing move from St Etienne in order to create new attacking opportunities.
50' The ball goes out of play. St Etienne are awarded a corner kick.
49' Aimen Moueffek (St Etienne) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The linesman makes the right call and St Etienne will have a corner.
47' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lens.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Romain Lissorgue has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Looks like M'Bala Nzola (Lens) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
45+1' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) is penalised for holding. Romain Lissorgue signals a set piece.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' So close! Mathis Amougou (St Etienne) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
45' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 0:3.
43' Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
41' Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
39' Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

37' A cross by Florian Sotoca (Lens) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St Etienne.
35' Aimen Moueffek (St Etienne) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Romain Lissorgue blows for a foul.
31' Facundo Medina (Lens) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
30' The St Etienne players are exchanging some short passes.
28' Kevin Danso (Lens) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
24' 25:75 – the latest ball possession ratio.

21' 0 - 1 Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) scores an incredible goal! He receives a pass, makes some space for himself and unleashes a long-range low shot which ends up in the middle of the net. The goalkeeper really underestimated the effort.
20' The linesman points to the corner flag, Lens are going to take it.

19' Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Lens will have a chance to score from a corner.
17' The referee blows his whistle as Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) was too aggressive in his challenge.
16' The referee signals a corner kick to Lens.
16' Andy Diouf (Lens) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lens.
16' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lens.
11' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Lens as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
11' Referee Romain Lissorgue makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
11' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
10' Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for a foul after Yunis Abdelhamid (St Etienne) hacks down one of his opponents. PENALTY AWARDED to Lens!
8' Andy Diouf (Lens) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Gautier Larsonneur makes a smart save to deny him.
7' Lens control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
4' Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
2' The Lens players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
